title: POST /checkout_sessions/{id}/cancel
context: Completes the session lifecycle per PRD §5.2.
objective: Implement cancel: only allowed on non-completed sessions.
scope_in: Cancel a created/updated session -> status=cancelled, AuditEntry written
Attempting to cancel a completed session returns a clear error
acceptance_criteria: Cancelling a valid session returns HTTP 200 and status=cancelled
Cancelling a completed session returns HTTP 409 or similar with a clear message, not a silent no-op
AuditEntry written for every successful cancel
